title: Companies: fundraising nights and collaborations · AquaTerra
description: For companies and CSR teams: sponsor or take a stall at AquaTerra's student nights, or work with us on a drive. AquaTerra takes no monetary donations.
lede: AquaTerra takes no monetary donations. A company can still take part: sponsor one of the student nights that pay for our welfare drives, take a stall at one, or work with us on a collaboration. Since {firstYear} we have run {count} drives that are fundraising nights, sports fundraisers, collaborations and food distribution days.

sections.heading: the nights that pay for the work
body: Most of what a company can join is a student night. Disco Diwali has run every autumn since 2024. Its latest edition, The Masquerade Sangeet Edition, was held on 10 November 2026 at 60, Chowringhee Banquets, with a mirror ball over the dance floor. The night's own description says every ticket funded AquaTerra's welfare drives.

Other nights follow the same pattern. Paradox is a student-run fest of sport, business, creative and cultural events in Kolkata, held from 1 to 6 June 2026, and its proceeds fund welfare. TerraThon, the student sports festival, ran from 2 to 4 October 2026 with cricket, pickleball and a solo FIFA league. The full list is on [every night that paid for the work](/impact/the-nights-that-fund-the-work).

sections.heading: sports nights and collaborations
body: Sports fundraisers have been part of the calendar since 2022. Turf Wars was held at Elgin Turf in March 2022, Turf It Up at Sky Turf in December 2022, Match with a Mission at VS Arena in July 2023, and Shoot for the Stars, a basketball fundraiser, at Chetla Park Athletic Club in December 2024. Each was run by student volunteers to raise money for welfare.

The collaborations are the other side of this. In December 2025 and again in March 2026, AquaTerra ran a distribution drive at Science City with Vishwajagriti and Emami, handing out stationery kits to children. The March 2026 drive notes 300 stationery kits distributed.

sections.heading: what a company can do with us
body: AquaTerra does not take cash donations, so a company's help takes the form of a night, a stall or a joint drive. A company can sponsor one of the nights, such as Disco Diwali or TerraThon, or take a stall at it. Small businesses have taken part in Disco Diwali alongside the student team, so the night is also a place to meet the people who run it.

A company can also work with us on a drive. The Science City stationery collaborations are the example on this site. The way in is the [collaborations page](/collaborations) or the [contact page](/contact), where a company can describe what it wants to do.

sections.heading: what the nights fund
body: The money from the nights funds AquaTerra's welfare drives: the feeding, clothes, book, plantation and workshop drives written up on this site. AquaTerra is self-funded. Its welfare work is paid for through its own student-run events and through [Crftd](/crftd), its student streetwear label. Students plan and run the nights, and students run the drives they pay for, so a sponsor works with the same team that does the welfare work.

learnings: Disco Diwali has run every autumn since 2024, so a company can plan for the night as a yearly slot.
Sponsorship and stalls are the two ways in at a night, and collaborations are the way in on a drive.
Collaborations can repeat: the Science City stationery drive ran in December 2025 and again in March 2026.

faqs.q: Does AquaTerra accept donations from companies?
faqs.a: AquaTerra takes no monetary donations. Companies can sponsor one of its student nights, take a stall at one, or work with AquaTerra on a drive. The [collaborations page](/collaborations) is the place to start.

faqs.q: Can a company sponsor AquaTerra's fundraising nights?
faqs.a: Yes. Companies can sponsor AquaTerra's student nights, such as Disco Diwali and TerraThon, or take a stall at them. The money raised from the nights funds AquaTerra's welfare drives.

faqs.q: What events can a company join with AquaTerra?
faqs.a: The main nights are Disco Diwali, which has run every autumn since 2024, Paradox, the student fest held in June, TerraThon, the student sports festival held in October, and The Summer AQ Turns Five, the anniversary party.

faqs.q: Has AquaTerra worked with a company on a drive?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra ran a collaboration with Vishwajagriti and Emami at Science City, distributing stationery kits to children in December 2025 and again in March 2026.
Students run them. AquaTerra's members are students aged fourteen to nineteen, and they plan and run the nights as student-run events.
